title: 构造 1.16

source.quote: Construction 1.16. Let A be an additive cateogry and A_{∗}∈Ch(A)_{≥0}.

conclusion: 定义单纯对象 $\mathrm{DK}_{\bullet}(A)$：$\mathrm{DK}_{n}(A)\defeq\bigoplus_{\alpha\colon[n]\twoheadrightarrow[k]}A_{k}$，连接态射按交换方块分别贡献 $\id_{A_{k}}$ 与 $d\colon A_{k}\to A_{k-1}$。
